spec.title: DAG Start to Order Signal Generation Latency
Selini Strategies — Trading PnL Decomposition
spec.description: One row per strategy. Trading PnL = Total PnL − Positional PnL, where Positional PnL = qty_at(start) × (mid_at(end) − mid_at(start)). Mid uses bid as proxy. Footer = totals across selected strategies.
